q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month. It includes unlimited notes and up to 3 devices. Annual billing saves 20%.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so for 5 people it's $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: The free plan allows up to 100 notes on 1 device.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days, so you're eligible. Please email support@example.com with your order number to request a refund.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Plus subscriptions can only be refunded within 14 days of purchase. Since three weeks exceeds that period, a refund is no longer available.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use Example Notes in any modern web browser. The web app supports all core features.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Example Notes requires Android 12 or later, so it doesn't run on Android 11. You can use the web app in your browser instead.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: The web app needs an internet connection to work. For offline access, please use our mobile or desktop apps instead; those sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export. You can export all notes as PDF there. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: You can recover notes from Trash within 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore". Your note from yesterday is still there.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS codes are not supported for two-factor authentication. We only support authenticator apps. You can enable it in Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the attachment size limit is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you keep Plus features until the end of your current billing period. After canceling, your account stays active with paid features until the subscription term expires.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day. You can email support@example.com to contact a human.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: Plus allows you to use up to 3 devices.
